$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the photography-music pack composed with an East Nashville music photographer's content seed (Theo Marsh, the young garage, soul, indie and hip-hop scene), an ink brand, and the liner register. home.layout "records" in the seed turns the home page into the record wall — one full-bleed frame, a tight grid of square album covers with invented artists and titles, then one line and a text link. Everything else — builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Album-art photographer
description: A music photographer's site on near-black for a young scene: one full-bleed live frame, then a record wall — a tight grid of square album covers, each with its artist and title — and one line with a text link to get in touch. Albums, client proofing galleries, and a live studio calendar behind it — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's /book slot picker and Manage calendar open on Theo's own sessions, not the base demo photographer's.

types.name: Cover shoot
types.description: A night or an afternoon for the sleeve — in the room the record sounds like, with the light it needs.

types.name: Press shoot
types.description: Two hours for the one-sheet, the festival program and the poster — direct flash, a bold wall, your attitude.

types.name: Listening session
types.description: An hour at the studio with the demos and a pot of coffee, to find the picture before we shoot it.

theme.$comment: The liner register's brand overlay: the preset's own warm-ink accents as the project brand, so app surfaces wear the same sleeve-stock register as the marketing pages (the pages resolve brand over preset accent; identical values mean no shift). mode dark opens on the register's near-black stock, so the night-lit live frames and the hero bleed into the page (the warm-white light mode was shot too and read weaker for this scene); theme is set whole because it merges shallowly. The base's burger-overlay nav is inherited: the name alone over the photograph, the links folded away.

landing.$comment: The liner register over the base's routes. pages replaces the base's skeletons wholesale, so every routed page is pinned: home is the record wall (a one-frame gallery sequence, the covers gallery, the colophon banner); the rest keep the base's compositions.
